objectives.en: Explain the elements of business ethics

narration.en: A shopkeeper legally sells an item but hides a known defect from the buyer. No law was broken. Was it right?
narration.kn: ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನು ಕಾನೂನುಬದ್ಧವಾಗಿ ವಸ್ತು ಮಾರುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಆದರೆ ತಿಳಿದ ದೋಷವನ್ನು ಗ್ರಾಹಕನಿಂದ ಮುಚ್ಚಿಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಯಾವುದೇ ಕಾನೂನು ಮುರಿದಿಲ್ಲ. ಅದು ಸರಿಯೇ?

body.en: Ethics is concerned with what is right and wrong in human behaviour judged by standards of society. Business ethics refers to the socially determined moral principles which should govern business activities, such as charging fair prices, giving correct weights, behaving well with customers and not adulterating goods. Business ethics and social responsibility are closely related: an ethical business is more likely to be socially responsible.
body.kn: ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ನೈತಿಕತೆ ಎಂದರೆ ನ್ಯಾಯಯುತ ಬೆಲೆ, ಸರಿಯಾದ ತೂಕದಂತಹ ಸಮಾಜ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುವ ನೈತಿಕ ತತ್ವಗಳು.

points.en: Fair prices, correct weights, no adulteration

narration.en: Business ethics are the moral principles society expects every business to follow, such as fair prices and honest weights.

explanation.en: Ethics starts at the top, is written down, is checked, is practised by everyone and is measured.

right.en: The CEO turns down a deal that needs a bribe, in front of the team
A written code on honesty and fair dealing is given to every employee
An ethics officer checks that big decisions follow the code
A yearly ethics audit of how well the code was followed

body.en: Top management commitment: the CEO and senior managers must lead by example. Publication of a code: a written code of ethics covering honesty, fairness and protection of the environment. Establishment of compliance mechanisms: systems to check that decisions follow the code. Involving employees at all levels: ethics must be practised by everyone. Measuring results: auditing and monitoring how well the code is followed.
body.kn: ಐದು ಅಂಶಗಳು: ಉನ್ನತ ಆಡಳಿತದ ಬದ್ಧತೆ, ಪ್ರಕಟಿತ ನೀತಿಸಂಹಿತೆ, ಅನುಸರಣಾ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ, ಎಲ್ಲಾ ನೌಕರರ ಒಳಗೊಳ್ಳುವಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಫಲಿತಾಂಶಗಳ ಮಾಪನ.

body.en: Think of the word 'Top Codes Comply, Involve, Measure': Top management commitment, Code published, Compliance mechanism, Involve employees, Measure results.

mnemonic.en: T-C-C-I-M: Top, Code, Comply, Involve, Measure

narration.en: Five elements in order: Top management commitment, publish a Code, Compliance mechanisms, Involve employees, and Measure results.

problem.en: A bank finds its staff are mis-selling insurance to elderly customers. Using the elements of business ethics, what should it do?

steps.en: The chairman openly commits that mis-selling will not be tolerated (top management commitment).
A written code of conduct for selling is issued to all branches (publication of a code).
A compliance team checks sales calls and customer complaints (compliance mechanism).
Branch staff join ethics workshops, and complaint data are audited every quarter (involving employees, measuring results).

answer.en: Apply all five elements: commitment, code, compliance, involvement and measurement.
